test_title: PYST 91: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends Olivia, Peter, Rachel, Sam, Toby, and Victoria are sitting around a circular table facing the center. Olivia is sitting to the immediate right of Peter. Peter and Toby are neighbours. Sam is not sitting next to Rachel or Toby. Victoria is sitting to the immediate right of Sam. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Sam and Rachel?
solution:
Given: Six friends Olivia, Peter, Rachel, Sam, Toby, and Victoria.

1) Olivia is sitting to the immediate right of Peter.

2) Peter and Toby are neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5842842f76cacbe9b6d638e8fe9611c8da81d42571f79aacd96eba0a8ba2a08a.png] 

3) Sam is not sitting next to Rachel or Toby.

4) Victoria is sitting to the immediate right of Sam.

**Final arrangement:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d73daf6d9107512c2d4afa8925e06beebab1fc3a05be68fcefcf79866f3a24e.png] 

So, **Victoria **is the immediate neighbour of both Sam and Rachel.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Victoria**".
